subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide in first-party docs once the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected, and should turnkey hardware references stay out of that page?
rationale: The linked issue explicitly asks for a maintainer boundary between first-party hardware setup docs and vendor/ecosystem promotion; automation can repair docs accuracy but cannot choose the product scope.

options.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
options.body: Accept the vendor-neutral Jetson guide after the JetPack/flashing instructions match NVIDIA sources and commercial turnkey references are omitted.

options.title: Route Outside Core Docs
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep Jetson-specific or turnkey hardware guidance in vendor, community, or ClawHub-owned documentation.

options.title: Defer For Hardware Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer or contributor provides real Jetson setup proof in addition to the docs repair.

recommendation.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
recommendation.body: Accept the vendor-neutral Jetson guide after the JetPack/flashing instructions match NVIDIA sources and commercial turnkey references are omitted.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed owner for VISION/ClawHub scope and first-party docs boundaries among the likely owners.
